reading.text:
Common setting (paper §1-§2, used by every reading below). Horizon T>0, dimensions n,m,d>=1.
H = R^n x R^m x R^{m x d} x L^2(nu;R^m) with the l^2-combined norm
|theta|_H^2 = |x|^2+|y|^2+|z|_F^2+||u||_{L^2(nu)}^2 (Euclidean on vectors, Frobenius on matrices,
L^2(nu) on the fibre; u an a.e.-class). P_2(H): Borel probability measures on H with finite second
moment, metrised by W_2 built on |.|_H. Coefficients are deterministic functions
b:[0,T]xHxP_2(H)->R^n, sigma:->R^{n x d}, h:->L^2(nu;R^n), f:->R^m, g:R^n x P_2(R^n)->R^m.
Diagonal input at t: Theta in L^2(Omega,F_t;H) on the standing basis together with mu=Law(Theta).
All hypotheses are diagonal (mu never varied independently of Theta), interior ones for a.e. t in
[0,T] with the null time set chosen before the inputs, terminal ones for all X_T,X'_T in
L^2(Omega,F_T;R^n) with induced laws rho=Law(X_T). The standing filtration is the usual augmentation
of the one generated by W, N and an independent F_0. Since the stability constant is claimed
dimension-free, norm choices matter: Euclidean/Frobenius/L^2(nu) norms (or a choice differing from
them only by dimension-free factors) are required wherever a definition enters a quantitative bound.

UNIT def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Spec.LipInterior
Paper notion: the interior half of Assumption 2.3, for a given constant L: "for a.e. t in [0,T]
and all (Theta,mu),(Theta',mu') in D_t, |db|+|dsigma|_F+||dh||+|df| <= L(|dX|+|dY|+|dZ|_F+||dU||
+W_2(mu,mu')) almost surely".
What a faithful Lean definition must be: for a.e. t with respect to Lebesgue measure on [0,T]
(volume restricted to Icc 0 T, Ioc 0 T, or "forall^m t, t in [0,T] -> ..."; NOT for a.e. t on all
of R, which would impose the condition on junk times outside [0,T] - a stronger assumption - and
NOT for every t, which is also stronger), LipInteriorAt L t. The null set of times must not depend
on the inputs, i.e. "forall^m t, forall Theta Theta', ..." (and not "forall Theta Theta',
forall^m t" - though inputs depend on t, so the former is the only coherent reading).

comparison.text:
Comparison: def Spec.LipInterior (Spec/Assumptions.lean:128-134) vs locked reading.
Lean: LipInterior ℱ P T L C := ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)), LipInteriorAt ℱ P t L C.
- a.e. t with respect to Lebesgue measure on [0,T] (restriction to Icc 0 T), not on all of ℝ and
  not every t: Match with the reading's requirement.
- The null set of times comes first, then the inputs (inside LipInteriorAt): Match.
- Constant L fixed outside. Match.
Verdict: faithful.
